scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Sports report! Our school volleyball team won the regional cup — Oliver scored the last point!

activities.title: Read the sentences and write the sport words.

activities.title: Match the sport with what you need.
Listen to Diego's sports report. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (comentarista deportivo) y Oliver (héroe del partido).
data.script: Diego: Welcome to the final! Our team is playing in blue. … Diego: The score is fourteen–fourteen. The next point wins! … Diego: Ingrid jumps… she passes to Oliver… … Diego: Oliver hits the ball over the net… POINT! We are the champions! … Oliver: I can't believe it! My arm still hurts! … Diego: The team receives the gold cup and a special prize: pizza for a month! … Oliver: The best part? Kili flew over the court with our flag!
